name: azclaude
description:
AZCLAUDE installs 12 commands, 10 auto-invoked skills, 16 agents, 5 hooks, a real-time pipeline visualizer and a persistent knowledge base — in one command.

It ships only what Claude Code does not already do. Health checks, security review, code review, scheduling, parallel dispatch, workflows and rewind are native now, and AZCLAUDE defers to them rather than reimplementing them.

Key features:
• Spec-driven workflow — /constitute writes project rules, /spec writes structured acceptance criteria, /clarify resolves ambiguity, /blueprint derives a file-level plan and waits for explicit approval before any code is written
• Knowledge layer — /ingest turns documents into linked, confidence-scored knowledge pages with code_refs back to source; /knowledge browses and health-checks them. Native auto-memory is machine-local; this is not
• Autonomous mode — /copilot works through a milestone plan across sessions (orchestrator → problem-architect → milestone-builder) until the work ships
• Memory across sessions — goals.md and checkpoints are injected at session start
• Dev loop discipline — /fix runs a 4-phase reproduce-investigate-hypothesise-verify protocol; /add, /test and /ship carry a completion rule that forbids claiming success without output

Example use cases:
• /setup — scan an existing project, detect stack and domain, fill CLAUDE.md, generate project-specific skills and agents
• /copilot "Build a compliance SaaS with trilingual support" — walk away, come back to working code across multiple sessions
• /constitute + /spec + /blueprint — govern a risky change with non-negotiables, testable criteria and an approved plan before the first line of code
• /ingest your docs — build a knowledge base the agents actually consume

Zero dependencies — no npm packages, no external APIs, no vector databases. Plain markdown and Claude Code's native extension points.
